subtopics.title: Set diagrams
subtopics.zero: All = one set inside another. No = separate sets. Some = at least one overlap.
subtopics.visual: All A are B: A ⊂ B
subtopics.rule: Only accept what must be true.

examples.question: All cats animals; all animals living
Some pens books; all books useful
No A is B; Some B are C

subtopics.traps: Some A are B does not mean all A are B.
